# Quality flags

Each record's `quality_status` is the most severe of its flags: INFO flags leave it `VALID`; WARNING, REVIEW_REQUIRED and INVALID set it to that status. Missing optional fields never make a record INVALID.

| Code | Severity | What it means | Why it matters | What the engine does | Review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MISSING_TRANSACTION_CODE` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Transaction code is missing | Without a code the transaction cannot be classified. | Kept the record and classified it as Unknown. | yes |
| `UNRECOGNIZED_TRANSACTION_CODE` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Transaction code is not a Form 4 code | An unknown code may be a typo or a new SEC code; guessing could misclassify it. | Kept the record and classified it as Unknown. | yes |
| `MISSING_TRANSACTION_DATE` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Transaction date is missing | The record cannot be placed in time, so date filters and charts will skip it. | Kept the record with a null transaction date. | yes |
| `INVALID_TRANSACTION_DATE` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Transaction date cannot be read | The source date is not a valid calendar date. | Set the transaction date to null and kept the source value. | yes |
| `MISSING_SHARES` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Share quantity is missing | Totals and transaction values cannot include this record. | Kept the record with null shares. | yes |
| `VALUE_REPORTED_INSTEAD_OF_SHARES` | INFO | Total value reported instead of shares | Some derivative transactions are reported by total value, not quantity. | Kept the reported total value in source_values; shares are null. | no |
| `INVALID_SHARES` | INVALID | Share quantity is not a valid number | The quantity cannot be used in any calculation. | Set shares to null and kept the source value. | yes |
| `INVALID_PRICE` | INVALID | Price is not a valid number | The price cannot be used in any calculation. | Set the price to null and kept the source value. | yes |
| `INVALID_NUMBER` | WARNING | A numeric field is not a valid number | A secondary amount, such as holdings after the transaction, cannot be used. | Set that field to null and kept the source value. | no |
| `NEGATIVE_AMOUNT` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | A quantity or price is negative | Form 4 amounts are reported as positive numbers with an A/D direction. | Kept the value as filed. | yes |
| `MISSING_PRICE` | WARNING | Purchase or sale has no price | The transaction value cannot be calculated for a trade that should have one. | Left price and transaction value null. Nothing was estimated. | no |
| `MISSING_PRICE_NON_TRADE` | INFO | No price reported | Awards, gifts and similar transactions often have no price. | Left price and transaction value null. | no |
| `ZERO_PRICE_TRADE` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Purchase or sale reported at a price of zero | A zero-price purchase or sale is unusual and may be a filing error or a non-market transfer. | Kept the zero price; transaction value is null. | yes |
| `ZERO_PRICE` | INFO | Price reported as zero | Common for awards and gifts; there is no market value to compute. | Kept the zero price; transaction value is null. | no |
| `WEIGHTED_AVERAGE_PRICE` | INFO | Price is a weighted average | The trade was executed in several lots; the footnote gives the price range. | Kept the reported average price. | no |
| `PRICE_OUTLIER` | WARNING | Price differs sharply from nearby trades | The price is more than 50% away from the median price of other purchases and sales of the same company within seven days. It may be a typo, a stock split, or a different security. | Kept the price as filed. | yes |
| `TRANSACTION_AFTER_FILING` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Transaction date is after the filing date | A filing cannot report a trade that has not happened yet. | Kept both dates as filed. | yes |
| `LATE_FILING` | INFO | Filed more than two business days after the transaction | Form 4 is generally due within two business days. Late filings delay public disclosure. Business days are approximated with the NYSE calendar. | No change; noted for research. | no |
| `MISSING_FILING_TIMESTAMP` | WARNING | Acceptance timestamp is missing | Without it the disclosure time and point-in-time views fall back to the filing date. | Treated the filing as public at 5:30 p.m. Eastern on its filing date, the latest time that keeps that date, so point-in-time views never see it early. | no |
| `MISSING_ACQUIRED_DISPOSED` | WARNING | Acquired/disposed code is missing | The direction of the trade is unknown. | Set direction to UNKNOWN. | no |
| `DIRECTION_CODE_MISMATCH` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Direction contradicts the transaction code | For example, a purchase (P) reported as a disposition. One of the two fields is probably wrong. | Kept both as filed and lowered classification confidence to LOW. | yes |
| `MISSING_OWNERSHIP_TYPE` | WARNING | Direct/indirect ownership is missing | Ownership filters will not include this record. | Left ownership_type null. | no |
| `INVALID_OWNERSHIP_TYPE` | WARNING | Direct/indirect code is not D or I | The ownership type cannot be determined. | Left ownership_type null. | no |
| `INDIRECT_WITHOUT_NATURE` | WARNING | Indirect ownership with no nature given | Form 4 asks filers to describe indirect ownership (e.g. 'By Trust'). | No change. | no |
| `DIRECT_WITH_NATURE` | WARNING | Direct ownership with an indirect-ownership note | The ownership fields contradict each other. | Kept both as filed. | no |
| `HOLDINGS_INCONSISTENT` | WARNING | Holdings after the trade do not follow | Shares owned after this transaction differ from the previous row's holdings plus or minus this trade, for the same security and ownership. Rows may be out of order, or an amount may be wrong. | Kept the values as filed. | no |
| `MISSING_INSIDER_CIK` | WARNING | Reporting owner has no CIK | The insider cannot be reliably matched across filings. | Kept the name; insider_cik is null. | no |
| `INVALID_INSIDER_CIK` | WARNING | Reporting owner CIK is not valid | The insider cannot be reliably matched across filings. | Set insider_cik to null and kept the source value. | no |
| `MULTIPLE_REPORTING_OWNERS` | INFO | Joint filing with several reporting owners | The same transaction is reported for several owners. Counting it once per owner would double-count shares. | Kept one record, attributed to the first owner, with all owners listed in reporting_owners. | no |
| `POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_IN_FILING` | WARNING | Identical row in the same filing | Two rows have identical values. They may be separate trades or a duplicate. | Kept both rows. | yes |
| `POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_ACROSS_FILINGS` | WARNING | Same trade appears in another filing | Another filing reports a trade with the same date, code, shares and price. Often several related owners (a fund and its general partner) file separately for one trade, which would double-count it. | Kept all records and linked them in related_transaction_ids. | yes |
| `SUPERSEDED` | INFO | Replaced by an amendment | A later Form 4/A restates or corrects this record. | Excluded from the current view; kept in the full and point-in-time views. | no |
| `AMENDMENT_ORIGINAL_NOT_FOUND` | WARNING | Original filing not found for amendment | The amended filing could not be linked to an original in this dataset, often because it falls outside the fetched date range. | Kept the amendment's records in the current view. | no |
| `AMENDMENT_AMBIGUOUS` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Amendment could not be matched confidently | Several originals could be the one amended, or the amended rows do not line up with the original rows. | Excluded this amendment record from the current view; the earlier records stay current. | yes |
| `AMENDMENT_MATCHED_BY_POSITION` | WARNING | Amendment matched by row position | The amended row changes the date, code or security, so it was matched to the original row in the same position. | Replaced the original row with the amended row. | no |
| `AMENDMENT_MAY_REMOVE` | REVIEW_REQUIRED | Amendment did not restate this record | The amendment's table has no rows, which can mean the record was reported in error and removed. | Kept the record in the current view. | yes |
| `ORIGINAL_NOT_RESTATED` | INFO | Not restated by the amendment | The filing was amended, but this record was not part of the amendment. | Kept the record in the current view. | no |
| `FOOTNOTE_NOT_FOUND` | WARNING | Referenced footnote is missing | A field cites a footnote that is not in the filing. | Kept the footnote id with no text. | no |
| `NOT_SUBJECT_TO_SECTION_16` | INFO | Filer is no longer subject to Section 16 | The filer checked the box indicating it is no longer subject to Section 16. | No change. | no |

# Transaction codes

| Code | Description | Group | Category | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P` | Open market or private purchase | General transaction codes | Market Purchase | HIGH |
| `S` | Open market or private sale | General transaction codes | Market Sale | HIGH |
| `V` | Transaction voluntarily reported earlier than required | General transaction codes | Other | LOW |
| `A` | Grant, award or other acquisition from the issuer (Rule 16b-3(d)) | Rule 16b-3 transaction codes | Equity Compensation | MEDIUM |
| `D` | Disposition to the issuer (Rule 16b-3(e)) | Rule 16b-3 transaction codes | Other | HIGH |
| `F` | Payment of exercise price or tax liability by delivering or withholding securities | Rule 16b-3 transaction codes | Tax-Related | HIGH |
| `I` | Discretionary transaction under Rule 16b-3(f) | Rule 16b-3 transaction codes | Other | HIGH |
| `M` | Exercise or conversion of derivative security exempted under Rule 16b-3 | Rule 16b-3 transaction codes | Derivative Exercise | MEDIUM |
| `C` | Conversion of derivative security | Derivative securities codes | Conversion | HIGH |
| `E` | Expiration of short derivative position | Derivative securities codes | Other | HIGH |
| `H` | Expiration (or cancellation) of long derivative position with value received | Derivative securities codes | Other | HIGH |
| `O` | Exercise of out-of-the-money derivative security | Derivative securities codes | Derivative Exercise | HIGH |
| `X` | Exercise of in-the-money or at-the-money derivative security | Derivative securities codes | Derivative Exercise | HIGH |
| `G` | Bona fide gift | Other Section 16(b) exempt transaction and small acquisition codes | Gift or Transfer | HIGH |
| `L` | Small acquisition under Rule 16a-6 | Other Section 16(b) exempt transaction and small acquisition codes | Other | HIGH |
| `W` | Acquisition or disposition by will or the laws of descent and distribution | Other Section 16(b) exempt transaction and small acquisition codes | Gift or Transfer | HIGH |
| `Z` | Deposit into or withdrawal from voting trust | Other Section 16(b) exempt transaction and small acquisition codes | Other | HIGH |
| `J` | Other acquisition or disposition (described in footnotes) | Other transaction codes | Other | LOW |
| `K` | Transaction in equity swap or instrument with similar characteristics | Other transaction codes | Other | HIGH |
| `U` | Disposition pursuant to a tender of shares in a change of control transaction | Other transaction codes | Other | HIGH |
